translations.english: The falling Rakshasas, who resembled dark blue clouds and wore dangling jewel necklaces and earrings, were continuously seen falling like blue mountains being struck down. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तमः सर्गः ।। 7 ।। Thus ends the seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
